children: Dominari Holdings authorized a share repurchase program of up to $5 million to buy back outstanding common stock.
Board authorized a share repurchase program with an aggregate purchase limit of $5,000,000.
Repurchases may be executed in open-market transactions and via Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18 plans.
Program timing, amounts and prices depend on market, business conditions and regulatory constraints.
Authorization may be terminated by the company at any time at its discretion.
